name: scrooge-kit
description: Token-saving plugins: rtk terminal-output compression, Headroom MCP blob compression, Serena symbol-level retrieval, token-hygiene skill.

plugins.name: scrooge-kit
plugins.description: Transparently routes terminal commands through rtk (60-90% output compression) + token-hygiene skill.

plugins.name: scrooge-headroom
plugins.description: Headroom MCP server (headroom_compress / headroom_retrieve / headroom_stats). Install only if the `headroom` CLI is on PATH: pip install "headroom-ai[all]".

plugins.name: scrooge-serena
plugins.description: Serena MCP server: symbol-level code retrieval/editing over LSP — read symbols, not whole files. Install only if the `serena` CLI is on PATH: uv tool install serena-agent.
